name: OpenVibe.Vision

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the PostgreSQL database, Valkey, Network's JWKS, the Events subscriptions and OpenVibe.AI are what /api/ready checks)

drains: HTTP server closed and in-flight requests drained
telemetry interval and retention stopped, then the telemetry buffer flushed
PostgreSQL pool closed, then the Events subscriptions stopped

resumes.what: answers, compare samples and UI checks live in PostgreSQL; a restart reopens the pool and clears only the in-process rate limits and telemetry buffer, so saved rows stay readable by id
OpenVibe.Events redelivers network.account.export_requested and network.account.deleted that were pending during the stop; account_data_events applies each once, so a redelivery changes nothing

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: migration 0001 only creates Vision's own tables (answers, compare samples, UI checks, account-data receipts, telemetry); an earlier release reads none of them

leases.none: no claims: one process serves the site and the API

notes: Port 5130, unit openvibe-vision.service, database ov_vision. The Vision room (plan 2026-10-28 §5.8): ask a picture, read text with the local Tesseract 5 engine first, compare the local reader with up to three AI hints, and check HTML, a public URL or a screenshot for overflow, cut-off, low contrast, overlap and layering faults. OpenVibe.AI is the only model gateway (ai.run.create; the OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/chat/completions is workflow ai.complete); no provider key is held, no face recognition is used and no image bytes are stored. OAuth client `vision`; answers account export and deletion (ADR-033) and subscribes to the two account Events topics. v1 has no public records, so it has no Search outbox. Of Vision's four machine capabilities (vision.ask, vision.ocr, vision.compare, vision.ui_check), 0.235.0 registers only vision.ui.check, the route Design's Arena calls today; the other three are served but wait for a caller.

site.name: Vision
site.tagline: See with the best model for the job
site.what: Ask a picture a question, read its text with a local engine, compare models side by side with cost and latency, or point the UI check at a page to find overflow, cut-off text, low contrast, overlap and layering faults.
